experiment: One-script geometry, charge and sector selection comparison

representation.twist_family: E tensor D^k shifts every normalized charge by k; canonical untwisted construction is a carrier choice
representation.circle_globality: Q is center generator/3; its 2pi exponential equals the SU3 center action, and its standalone period is 6pi

minimal_carrier.family: Exactly one copy of each degree 0,1,2,3, each positive degree either original or conjugate; no character twists or extra summands
minimal_carrier.conclusion: E and its full conjugate are the only determinant-trivial choices in this finite family; their triplet types match automatically
minimal_carrier.premise: A preferred parallel complex volume on the carrier is an extra selection criterion, not a consequence of orienting the real spatial normal bundle

projective.carrier: O + O(2)^3 + O(-1)^3 + O(-3), with constant quotient-space factors retained
projective.compatibility_status: Valid partial/global associated-bundle example; not a complete maintained sector chain

compatible_metric.ordinary_space: R4_x times R6_y, all noncompact physical spatial coordinates
compatible_metric.metric: g=sum dx_mu^2 + |dy+omega J y|^2, omega=b/2 (x1 dx2-x2 dx1)
compatible_metric.normal_connection: omega J, or i omega I3 in complex notation
compatible_metric.metric_properties: smooth, positive, determinant one; no boundary or compactification
compatible_metric.premises: Chosen metric and complex normal structure; an existence construction, not selected IDWT geometry
compatible_metric.scope: Normal connection need not preserve each intermediate real normal line; all listed submanifolds coexist

fixed_carrier_assignment_tests.restriction_scope: Same W/E extended by pullback from the depth-four base on the explicit R10 example
fixed_carrier_assignment_tests.assignment_qualification: The 24 and 4 counts do not impose a map from physical named channels to D. Such a map reduces counts by extra assumptions; the depth numbers still do not enter Q.
fixed_carrier_assignment_tests.warning: These are permitted identifications, not derived physical states. No branch-to-depth selector is present.

charge_twist_tests.carrier_family: 1 + (Lambda2 W tensor D^a) + D^b + (W* tensor D^c)
charge_twist_tests.admissible_m: m congruent 1 modulo 3; m is nonzero; all weights are m times original Q
charge_twist_tests.bounded_twist_domain: a,c in [-3,3]; b determined by exact determinant cancellation

relative_counterexample.lost_premise: The singlet and triplet transition lines are D^4 and D^2, rather than the same D

integer_character_scan.scope: all eight degree conjugations; three independent integer twists in [-8,8]
integer_character_scan.interpretation: Every accepted carrier is an overall charge rescaling, not a new relative-charge table

anisotropic_metric_test.metric: g=|dx|^2+|dy+omega J_lambda y|^2, omega=(x1 dx2-x2 dx1)/2
anisotropic_metric_test.changed: Charge identified with complete anisotropic holonomy instead of the central determinant component; color scalar property is lost
anisotropic_metric_test.qualification: This does not change Q when electric charge is still defined by the determinant component. It tests a relaxed identification.

sector_selector_tests.scope: Seven added uniform predicates, two complex-subspace policies, two compatible nested real flags
sector_selector_tests.premise: Only the intersection of each tangent sector with the fixed four-in-ten normal bundle enters the selector
sector_selector_tests.no_separation_reason: S_3=S_4=0. Every uniform function of this intersection and J alone gives the same retained spectrum at both depths.
sector_selector_tests.scope_limit: No exclusion of rules using additional base-tangent, embedding, curvature or physical branch data. Complex intersections define subbundles only on constant-rank regions.
